Developer name, release cadence, permissions and 'what's new' text date platform migrations.

negative_findings.description: Searching for live Kosovo job ads that explicitly name core banking products (Temenos T24, Oracle Flexcube) returned only non-Kosovo postings (US/Middle East aggregators) plus one technographics profile.
negative_findings.result_summary: No indexed Kosovo-located job ad naming a specific core banking product was retrievable through general web search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Platform names in Kosovo ads are likely present but not surfaced by general search engines because local boards render postings dynamically and delete them after the deadline. Collection must be on-board and continuous rather than retrospective via search.

negative_findings.description: The 'portalpune' brand resolves to two distinct sites — portalpune.com (Kosovo) and portalpune.al (Albania) — and search results conflate them; boilerplate 'market leader since 2008' text also appears in scraped-looking copy.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both domains exist and serve job listings; the Kosovo-relevant one is portalpune.com.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector configured on the wrong domain would silently gather Albanian rather than Kosovar vacancies, corrupting a market-level hiring signal.

negative_findings.description: No stable Albanian-language term for 'core banking system' emerged from search; local ads appear to use either the English phrase or loose descriptions ('sistemi bankar', 'sistemet e IT-së').
negative_findings.result_summary: Glossary gap: 'sistemi bazë bankare' is a constructed rather than attested term, and 'sistemi bankar' is noisy (it commonly means the banking sector as a whole, not the software).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Keyword rules built on 'sistemi bankar' will produce heavy false positives; matching should rely on English product names embedded in sq text plus role titles.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn job and profile search — the single highest-yield surface for platform-name leakage — is behind an auth wall and its ToS forbids automated collection.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only public company pages were reachable; no jobs listing content retrievable.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The richest signal in this cell cannot be automated; it needs an analyst seat or a licensed provider, which is a budget/process decision rather than an engineering one.

negative_findings.description: No Kosovo-specific hiring or presence footprint was found for Halcom or Printec in this pass, despite both being regional payments/e-banking vendors.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search surfaced Asseco SEE (Prishtina banking unit) and Comtrade Computers (bank clients listed via STIKK) but nothing Kosovo-located for Halcom or Printec.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Absence here is weak evidence only — these vendors may serve Kosovo from Ljubljana/Athens/Belgrade with no local hiring, so their footprint must be sought in tender records and partner directories instead of job boards.

coverage_gaps.description: Kosovo job postings are removed at deadline and are poorly archived, so historical hiring-burst analysis is impossible retroactively.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Stand up a daily snapshotting collector across KosovaJob, PortalPune, OfertaPune, PunaIme and DuaPune storing full posting text now; also submit board URLs to the Wayback Machine to build a retrievable trail.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language coverage for northern Kosovo rests on two Serbia-hosted boards; no Kosovo-Serb local board or municipal vacancy channel was identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search for Kosovo-Serb community portals and Serbian-parallel institution notice boards (e.g. municipal sites in Mitrovica Sever, Zvečan, Leposavić) and add any vacancy feeds found.

coverage_gaps.description: Bank-owned careers pages were not enumerated in this pass; many Kosovo banks post technical roles only on their own site, bypassing the boards entirely.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a per-bank careers-URL registry for all ~15 XK institutions (seed from the Open Banking Tracker XK list) and add each /karriera, /kariera, /vende-pune page to the crawler.

coverage_gaps.description: RFP-adjacent signals were only approached through PM job ads; no procurement/tender surface was covered in this cell (it belongs to another cell but the join is essential).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Cross-join PM/implementation hiring dates against Kosovo e-Procurement and BQK notices in the analysis layer, so a hiring burst can be matched to a live tender.

coverage_gaps.description: APK/SDK fingerprinting was identified as a method but no Kosovo bank APK was actually analysed, so no concrete SDK evidence exists yet.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the confirmed package IDs (com.quipugmbh.mba.kosovo, com.quipugmbh.mobilebanking.kosovo, com.bkt.bktkosovo, com.tebkos.TebMobile) through εxodus and AppBrain and record the resulting vendor SDK inventory per bank.

brief: Kosovo's weak-signal layer is unusually board-fragmented: at least eight Albanian-language job portals (KosovaJob, PortalPune, OfertaPune, PunaIme, DuaPune, Punesim, ShpalljePune, plus the Gjirafa jobs vertical) carry overlapping bank and vendor vacancies, while Serbian-language coverage for the north runs through Poslovi Infostud and HelloWorld.rs. The highest-value confirmed leaks in this pass were vendor-side rather than bank-side: Asseco SEE staffing a Prishtina BANKING unit, Comtrade Computers naming Kosovo bank clients in the STIKK directory, and mobile app package namespaces that identify the builder outright (ProCredit Kosova ships under Quipu GmbH's com.quipugmbh.* while BKT and TEB use own-brand namespaces). The binding constraints are ephemerality and access: postings vanish at deadline with no archive, LinkedIn — where product names like T24 or Flexcube actually appear — is auth-walled and ToS-restricted, and no attested Albanian term for 'core banking system' exists, so keyword rules must key on English product tokens inside sq text. Priority is to start daily snapshotting of the boards immediately and to fingerprint the four known bank APKs, since neither signal can be recovered retroactively.
